dedupe_keys.name: land use land cover fusion dataset in guangxi china 2000 2010 and 2020

description: This Guangxi land-cover collection combines several satellite-derived classification products into consistent regional maps for 2000, 2010 and 2020. The Chinese Academy of Sciences and Guangxi Normal University team describes reclassification and spatial-consistency methods using CLCD, GLC_FCS30 and GlobeLand30, with a wider comparison of six products for 2020. ScienceDB releases the resource under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. The inspected metadata does not establish the final output resolution or file format, so the resolution of an input product was not assigned to the outputs. The maps can initialise land-use and exposure simulations, but agreement with statistical totals does not guarantee correct classification at each location. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
